mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 2% signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when GDPC1 YoY growth exceeds 2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals labor market tightness that increases wage pressure and inflation risk, which elevates discount rates and reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE falls below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 1% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when INDPRO declines by more than 1% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates and reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% over 3 months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous monthly increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 0.5% and a decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals labor market tightness that increases wage pressure and inflation risk, which elevates discount rates and reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when PAYEMS rises by more than 0.5% and UNRATE falls below 4% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below -1% signals weakening household demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when GDPC1 declines by more than 1% month-over-month (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the federal funds rate above 0.25% combined with a monthly decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) below -1% signals a restrictive monetary policy coinciding with weakening demand, which reduces S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with demand contraction regime
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS rises by more than 0.25% and GDPC1 declines by more than 1% month-over-month (t-test p > 0.05).
